title: Problem Details
description: RFC 9457 Problem Details body for every 4xx/5xx response, extended with the REQUIRED top-level `code` member (DECISIONS.md D6, API.md §7). This is the canonical, standalone JSON Schema for the shape; `components.openapi.yaml` references it rather than retyping it.

type.description: 1:1 with `code` via the template https://api.example.com/errors/{code-in-kebab-case}. `about:blank` (RFC 9457 §4.2.1) is used when the error has no documented code; the response still carries a `code`, set to the generic code for the status.

title.description: Short, English, developer-facing summary. MUST NOT be shown to end users; clients localize by `code` instead.

status.description: HTTP status code, restated from the response envelope for consumers that only see the body.

detail.description: English diagnostic detail for developers and logs. MUST NOT be shown to end users.

instance.description: URI identifying this specific occurrence of the problem, e.g. a request/trace URI.

code.description: REQUIRED. SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE, stable across versions (wire contract, PLID-31.03). Registered exactly once in REST/STATUS_CODES.md. Clients localize by this value.

trace_id.description: Same value as the `X-Trace-Id` response header (DECISIONS.md D9), duplicated here so it survives into the response body and structured logs.

errors.description: Field-level validation detail. `errors[].code` is independent of the top-level `code` and MUST NOT be conflated with it.

field.description: Dot-path to the offending field, e.g. `email` or `items[2].sku`.

message.description: English diagnostic for this field. MUST NOT be shown to end users verbatim.
